entry.title: Attritional Cost-Exchange Ratios of Autonomous Loitering Swarms Versus Multi-Layered Air Defense
entry.summary:
Interceptor-to-target unit cost ratios exceeding $25:1$ create structural magazine-depth exhaustion under saturation salvos. Quantitative salvos modeling demonstrates that integrating directed-energy short-range defense with low-cost acoustic/RF sensor meshes restores positive cost-exchange equilibrium at engagement densities up to $180\text{ tracks/min}$.

Source: War on the Rocks / SIPRI · Tags: #defense-strategy #geopolitics
